title:
We tried to rollback.
The rollback script rolled forward
and deployed `main` again.
subtitle: The incident commander typed `git revert HEAD~1` but forgot about the 14 squashed merge commits from the release train. The rollback introduced 3 new bugs while failing to fix the original one.
logs: > script was written by an intern in 2022 who assumed linear git history.
> script pulled latest branch containing unreleased breaking changes.
> building and deploying untested main branch to 100% of fleet...
> 3 new catastrophic bugs have joined the party.
> Incident Commander has gone silent in the Zoom room.
> someone typed 'oof' in the war room chat.
footnote: Error code: `ROLL-SIDEWAYS-404` · Revert direction: Unpredictable · War room stress level: Critical
pathTemplate: We attempted to rollback `{path}`, but the rollback script got confused and deleted the database.
